title: 電解槽整流電源
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討電解槽極化、整流諧波與電流品質，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore electrolyzer polarization, rectifier harmonics and current quality, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。不提供製氫設備組裝、氣體處理與現場運轉程序；數值用於離線電量與電能核算。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. No hydrogen equipment assembly, gas handling or field operation procedures are provided; numerical work is offline charge/energy accounting.

stages.title: 電化學負載
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成電化學負載；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete electrochemical load through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 讀取電解槽 V–I 模型：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Read electrolyzer V–I models: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解讀取電解槽 V–I 模型，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand read electrolyzer v–i models through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 比較線性電阻和帶起始電壓的模型，在低電流區指出差異。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Compare a resistor with a threshold-plus-polarization model and identify low-current differences. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 比較線性電阻和帶起始電壓的模型，在低電流區指出差異。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Compare a resistor with a threshold-plus-polarization model and identify low-current differences. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「讀取電解槽 V–I 模型」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把電解槽極化、整流諧波與電流品質的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If read electrolyzer v–i models disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of electrolyzer polarization, rectifier harmonics and current quality behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「讀取電解槽 V–I 模型」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for read electrolyzer v–i models, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 讀取電解槽 V–I 模型：原理
knowledge.text: 電解槽不是固定電阻，其極化電壓隨電流和狀態改變。
knowledge.textEn: An electrolyzer is not a fixed resistor; polarization voltage changes with current and state.

knowledge.title: 讀取電解槽 V–I 模型：證據
knowledge.text: 比較線性電阻和帶起始電壓的模型，在低電流區指出差異。
knowledge.textEn: Compare a resistor with a threshold-plus-polarization model and identify low-current differences.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：理想法拉第電量模型 nH₂=I·t/(2F)，I=1,000 A、t=3,600 s、F=96,485 C/mol，單電解單元約產 18.66 mol H₂；N 個串聯單元理想總量再乘 N。此例未計法拉第效率、氣體狀態和輔機。 不提供製氫設備組裝、氣體處理與現場運轉程序；數值用於離線電量與電能核算。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: ideal Faraday accounting gives nH₂=I·t/(2F). At 1,000 A for 3,600 s with F=96,485 C/mol, one cell produces about 18.66 mol H₂. N series cells multiply ideal total production by N. Faradaic efficiency, gas conditions and auxiliaries are excluded. No hydrogen equipment assembly, gas handling or field operation procedures are provided; numerical work is offline charge/energy accounting.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「電解槽整流電源」的「讀取電解槽 V–I 模型：建立模型」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源來源、導體、負載、回流與保護的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「微電網：守住晚高峰」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓模型的接線圖、電流方向、測點與時間戳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Read electrolyzer V–I models: build the model” in “Electrolyzer rectifier power supplies”. Draw the source, conductor, load, return and protection boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Microgrid: Protect the Evening Reserve” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for isolated low-voltage wiring diagram, current direction, measurement points and timestamps, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.observation: 用 10 個 2 V 單元示例算 20 V 堆疊，對照總功率與產量倍數。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: For ten 2 V cells compute a 20 V stack and compare total power and production scaling. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「區分單元與堆疊」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把電解槽極化、整流諧波與電流品質的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If separate cells and stacks disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of electrolyzer polarization, rectifier harmonics and current quality behind one passing number.

knowledge.text: 串聯單元電流相同、總電壓相加，而各單元都產生氫。
knowledge.textEn: Series cells share current and add voltage, while each produces hydrogen.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：理想法拉第電量模型 nH₂=I·t/(2F)，I=1,000 A、t=3,600 s、F=96,485 C/mol，單電解單元約產 18.66 mol H₂；N 個串聯單元理想總量再乘 N。此例未計法拉第效率、氣體狀態和輔機。 不提供製氫設備組裝、氣體處理與現場運轉程序；數值用於離線電量與電能核算。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: ideal Faraday accounting gives nH₂=I·t/(2F). At 1,000 A for 3,600 s with F=96,485 C/mol, one cell produces about 18.66 mol H₂. N series cells multiply ideal total production by N. Faradaic efficiency, gas conditions and auxiliaries are excluded. No hydrogen equipment assembly, gas handling or field operation procedures are provided; numerical work is offline charge/energy accounting.
